messages:
lina: Quick triage — Notifications milestone (MVP) is at risk. Infra team flagged a 20% perf regression on the embeddings cache, and ACME asked for tenant-level opt-out which is nontrivial. Need cut/keep decisions by EOD.
sofia: ack. can we list candidate cuts that don't impact core retention or search quality?
ajay: short list: 1) tenant opt-out (delay to v1), 2) per-tenant analytics (v1), 3) rich preview images (v1), 4) incremental backoff for delivery (keep), 5) embeddings cache warmers (keep if infra can patch).
lina: agree with ajay's prioritization. customer ask on tenant opt-out is high-touch but not blocking launch for others. propose we defer it to v1.
marco: infra note — cache regression is from a kernel change rolled yesterday. rolling back the change reduces latency but increases cost ~8%. We can ship MVP with rollback + cost offset for first 4 weeks.
sofia: that sounds acceptable if finance signs off. we need explicit launch criteria: latency p50 < 120ms, errors < 0.5%, and opt-outs gated to v1.
lina: agreed. Drafting an updated milestone:
```
MILESTONE: Notifications MVP
- Scope: delivery, basic embedding-based ranking, user-level settings (no tenant opt-out)
- Launch criteria: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms, errors < 0.5%
- Must-have cuts: tenant opt-out (defer), rich previews (defer), per-tenant analytics (defer)
- Post-launch: rollout tenant opt-out in v1 with canary & audit logs
- Timeline: freeze -> 1 week rollback patch -> smoke -> canary -> GA (2w after rollback)
```
ajay: one operational ask — canary should target ACME and 2 small customers only, not internal prod. add a feature flag and a hard kill.
sofia: add the feature flag plan + telemetry points. also add a prompt for Redwood Console: add a per-route latency alert for notifications route.
marco: deploy-bot: starting rollback patch job window 0200-0500 UTC tomorrow.
deploy-bot: rollback job scheduled for 2023-11-08T02:00:00Z -> 2023-11-08T05:00:00Z. Notifying oncall. :white_check_mark:
lina: ok — decision: defer tenant opt-out to v1; rollback infra change; freeze scope for MVP as listed above; timeline shifts ~1 week for smoke and canary. folks, please update your PRs and ticket estimates.
sofia: i'll push an updated spec doc and tag @solutions for customer comms.
ajay: i'll prep the feature flag and limit canary routing. estimated 2 dev-days.
marco: i'll monitor the cache metrics post-rollback and confirm by noon after the job.
lina: thanks all. if any vetoes ping me now. otherwise i'll close the decision and update the roadmap. :raised_hands:
